## Master's thesis

**The Laguerre–Pólya Class, Jensen Polynomials and the Riemann Hypothesis**  
Chennai Mathematical Institute · 2025  
_Supervisor:_ [Siddhi Pathak](https://www.cmi.ac.in/~siddhi/)

This was an expository project on the Laguerre–Pólya class and the Jensen-polynomial approach to the Riemann hypothesis. As part of the project, I also translated Pólya and Schur's 1914 paper *Über zwei Arten von Faktorenfolgen in der Theorie der algebraischen Gleichungen* from German into English.
